title: Spinning Sphere of Molten Sodium
summary: Veritasium shows an experiment from Prof. Dan Lathrop's lab with a spinning sphere of molten sodium, used to study how turbulent convection in Earth's core generates a magnetic field. It is a short demonstration of dynamo physics.
why: Cited as a visual example of dynamo flows and of the care needed when handling reactive liquid sodium.

quote.text: using liquid sodium for... anything requires an enormous amount of care
